## Acceptance boundary

**Stage 11 owner-installed read-only baseline R10 PASS** on the new `_47` test package: installed package version observed; 73 extra Lua/BIN present by worker receipt and local Git-HEAD Remove plan; 25 Lua/100 BIN correctly exposed through cached inventory; native service and both process owners healthy; the three scoped native fingerprints and saved Config digest unchanged from the previously accepted `_46` R8.

**Not asserted:** no GUI/full-help screenshot or colors, F5, actual install/remove **after** upgrade, injected on-device cache refresh failure, post-failure rollback, changed operation correlation, absolute full IPFW state, checksum of downloaded on-device `.pkg`, historical Job byte hashes, or final working strategy result. In particular, the same `operation` and source `revision` as R8 show no newly evidenced resource transaction; they are a **good preservation result**, not a proof that new `_47` mutation paths have been exercised. The 8/8 cache fault-injection tests + Project/Voice/FreeBSD15 CI qualify source and package but are not an owner-live failure reproduction.

**Next single non-destructive owner action:** on installed `_47`, open Strategies → Full Help and verify that installed Lua/BIN two columns render the previously accepted `upstream` green / optional `other` blue, including after F5. Do **not** re-run Remove/Install or inject a native failure just to repeat accepted scenarios.
